subject: french
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in French on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (French↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.q: How do you say 'I play the piano' (an instrument)?
questions.explain: Instruments take 'jouer de': 'Je joue du piano'. Using 'jouer à' would wrongly treat it like a sport.
« Tricoter » means to knit; « le tricot » is knitting.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I spend too much time online'?
options: Je passe trop de temps en ligne
Je passe trop de temps en retard
Je passe peu de temps en ligne
questions.explain: 'Passer du temps' = 'to spend time' and 'trop de' = 'too much', so this means 'I spend too much time online'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I have to revise for my exams'?
options: Je dois réviser pour mes examens
questions.explain: 'Réviser' = 'to revise' and 'devoir' = 'to have to', so 'Je dois réviser pour mes examens' = 'I have to revise for my exams'.

questions.q: What does 'mener une vie saine' mean?
questions.explain: 'Sain/saine' means 'healthy', so 'mener une vie saine' = 'to lead a healthy life'.

questions.q: Which sentence means « The uniform is compulsory at my school »?
options: L'uniforme était obligatoire dans mon collège
L'uniforme est obligatoire dans mon collège
L'uniforme est facultatif dans mon collège
L'uniforme est interdit dans mon collège
questions.explain: « Obligatoire » = compulsory; « interdit » = forbidden and « facultatif » = optional are distractors.
« Un internat » is a boarding school; a boarder is « un(e) interne ». Don't confuse with « un stage » (internship).
'Le tabagisme' is the habit/addiction of smoking; a tobacconist's is 'le bureau de tabac'.
« Le sommeil » means sleep, e.g. « le manque de sommeil » = lack of sleep. A dream is « un rêve ».
« Se détendre » means to relax/unwind, e.g. « je me détends en écoutant de la musique ».

questions.q: Which sentence means 'You must avoid fatty foods'?
options: On doit boire les aliments gras
Il faut éviter les aliments gras
Il faut manger les aliments gras
questions.explain: 'Il faut' = 'one must' and 'éviter' = 'to avoid', so this means 'You must avoid fatty foods'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I play football' (a sport)?
questions.explain: Sports take 'jouer à': 'Je joue au football'. Instruments take 'jouer de' (e.g. 'je joue du piano').
'Le bien-être' literally means 'being well' and translates as 'wellbeing'.

questions.q: What does 'J'ai l'habitude de lire le soir' mean?
options: I have to read in the evening
I usually read in the evening
I would like to read in the evening
I used to read in the evening
questions.explain: 'Avoir l'habitude de' means 'to be in the habit of / usually do', so this is 'I usually read in the evening'.
